dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Apologies, our business has me distracted... Was there something you needed?

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Ah, we have let an outsider see the troubles our traitors have caused us... How shameful.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: But worry not. With Jeht's aid, Aderfi will soon be delivered unto rightful justice.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: He has already stained the Tanit name... This means that he has cast aside the name of his mother, and must be punished.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: As with nations or cities, tribes too must enforce their laws. I think you understand this.

choices.text: I'm just concerned that there isn't enough evidence...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Well... You are of the city-folk. It is unsurprising that you worry about matters such as "evidence" and "suspicions." This I understand.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: But for us Tanit, he has already stained the name of the tribe with his dishonor... Forgotten the name of his mother. Punishment must be delivered unto him.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Jeht? She is a good child. She learns our ways quickly and greets trouble with neither grimace nor complaints.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Heh. Speaking of her, it's a shame that there was an... incident between us and her father in years prior...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: But I'm just glad that Jeht has returned to us. Though her father... *sigh* I suppose we can consider this a delayed resolution.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: She likes you, you know. I can tell.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: So... Please don't disappoint her and ruin the friendship you have.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: He is my "son." Though not born of my flesh, I trust him very much.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Clever, loyal, strong, ethically unbending, and skilled in gaining favor with others. Like a loyal wolf to the pack, he has never failed me.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: It is a shame that he is... male.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: If he was a woman, he could take my place... That way, I could finally retire and lead the children in managing our Sumpter Beast caravans.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Heh... But at least I still have Jeht.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Farewell. I bid you safe travels for your coming adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Apologies, our business has me distracted... Was there something you needed?

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: You speak of Aderfi and Azariq, yes? Their actions have shamed the Tanit, and before a guest no less...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: They spent too long in contact with those northerners, and forgot that they were children of the Tanit, bound to the rules of the tribe.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Thankfully, I still have Jeht... She has lived up to my expectations and more.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Naturally, she has her own perspective. That which provoked her rancor was a misunderstanding regarding our actions...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: But if we wish to rejuvenate the desert, the lands need to be fertile, that they may offer an easier life for our people. Hence, we must rely on Liloupar's favor.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: We hope to come to a mutual understanding on this point at least...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Farewell. I bid you safe travels for your coming adventures.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: So the Mother of the Jinni no longer speaks, for she chose to leave us...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: That truly is... lamentable. Still, she returned to her destiny. Perhaps this might be the best ending she, of us all, could have attained.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: But a Jinni's power will not leave their contracted master. The bottle must contain some vestiges of her power, yes?

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Hehe. The Mother of the Jinn might have departed, but the pact remains. I hope that you can take care of it... and yourself... in the desert.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Farewell, most esteemed guest. Know that you will always be welcome amongst the Tanit.
